summary: Iteration 4: tested built-in music library (API + Studio MusicPicker + preview/client viewer playback), camera editor per-pin colors, viewer pin palette and watermark on PDF. Backend 55/55 pass (1 pre-existing skip). Frontend: all requested flows work; 1 functional bug found in camera editor FOV slider (keyboard change clears the camera), plus a CSS bug making the center watermark tiny.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing FOV with the keyboard (focus thumb + ArrowRight/Left) DELETES the selected camera. Radix Slider calls onValueCommit before onValueChange on keyboard input, so save(liveRef.current) runs with liveRef=null -> PATCH {clear_camera:true}. Reproduced: scene 2 camera became null. Changing FOV with the mouse works (fov 60->90 saved).

.eyebrow in index.css is unlayered and comes after @tailwind utilities, so its font-size:10.5px overrides text-[clamp(20px,5vw,64px)] on the center 'INERRE' watermark (shows ~10px on renders and PDF pages) and also overrides text-[9px] on other eyebrow elements (e.g. 'Default' tag). The watermark is visible on white PDF pages (mix-blend-difference works) but it is small.

issues: 'Tanpa musik' row is ~7px wider than the track rows (pr-[30px] does not match preview button width + gap 8px), so right edges are not aligned

action_items: PlanCameraEditor: in onValueCommit use the committed value, e.g. onValueCommit={([v]) => save({ ...(liveRef.current || sel!.camera!), fov: v })}, so a keyboard change never sends clear_camera
Move .eyebrow into @layer components (or remove 'eyebrow' from the watermark spans) so the text-[...] size utilities apply; check the watermark size afterwards
Minor: line up the right edge of the 'Tanpa musik' row with the track rows
critical_code_review_comments: PlanCameraEditor num(): a scene that is not in tour_order gets 0, so it shows '00' and the color of pin 1
MusicPicker.removeUpload sets source back to 'system' even when the user had chosen 'Tanpa musik' before uploading (backend delete_music always sets system). This may be intended.
MusicPicker choose(): reload is not awaited and there is no pending or disabled state, so fast double-clicks can race
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_T1 Music, TEST_T1 Media, and 2x TEST_UI Media T1 projects. All deleted. Sample project only read.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_music.py covers tracks, music-choice, the snapshot, and legacy revisions (it unsets snapshot.music in Mongo on its own TEST project). Use setup_ui_media.py [nomedia] for UI projects and ticket.py <role> for sign-in tickets. Verified: sample /view shows Revisi 02, music-toggle-btn, and gymnopedie playing on autoplay; pin 04 cone visible; editor pins, cones and list dots use pinColor, with cones drawn under the pins. Retest: keyboard FOV slider and watermark size.
rca of the issue: FOV keyboard bug: Radix Slider updateValues(commit:true) calls onValueCommit inside the setValues updater before useControllableState calls onValueChange, so liveRef.current is still null (it was reset by the previous save) and save(null) sends clear_camera:true. Repro: Studio > floor > select a scene that has a camera > focus the FOV thumb > press ArrowRight; the camera disappears.
